title:
#WorldMentalHealthDay

October 10th - World Mental Health Day.  A reminder for us all that there is No Health Without Mental Health.

The theme this year, determined by the World Federation for Mental Health is: Access to Services- Mental Health in Catastrophes and Emergencies.

Many communities over the globe continue to face fear, crisis and upheaval and mental health support is often not prioritised in humanitarian responses.

World Mental Health Day is a reminder that mental health must be treated as a core priority during and after emergencies. 

Everyone needs food, shelter, access to health care and  psychosocial support, and safe spaces, to recover and reconnect. 

Don't underestimate the power of empathy, kindness and care. 

Let's look after each other, folks!
